caseNameFull: First National Bank of Longview v. Henry Jackson
attorneys: Mr. R. E. Taylor for defendant in error in support of the motion., Mr. F. H. Prendergast for plaintiff in error in opposition to the motion. See post, p. 699.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction upon the authority of § 237 of the Judicial Code as amended by the act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, § 2, 39 Stat. 726; Jett Bros. Distilling Co. v. Carrollton, 252 U. S. 1, 5-6.
